title: Inattention Is Not Inefficiency: Correcting the Logic Behind the 2025 Proposed Vehicle Standard Rollback
The Efficiency of Dynamic Electricity Prices
abstract: The marginal cost of electricity fluctuates hour-by-hour, yet retail customers typically face flat prices. Using data from all seven US wholesale markets and a new method to evaluate alternative rates set in advance that accounts for equilibrium price effects, we estimate efficiency gains from time-varying price schedules that better align price with cost. We have three main results. First, time-of-use rates and critical-peak pricing, the two most common time-varying rate plans, each correct about 10% of mispricing. Second, complex rate structures based on historical prices often backfire. Third, real-time pricing with price ceilings can capture most potential efficiency gains while limiting customer risk.
abstract_zh: 电力的边际成本每小时都在波动，然而零售客户通常面对的是固定价格。利用美国全部七个批发市场的数据，并采用一种新方法评估预先设定的替代性费率（该方法考虑了均衡价格效应），我们估计了使价格更好地反映成本的时变电价计划所带来的效率收益。我们有三个主要结果。第一，分时电价（time-of-use rates）和尖峰电价（critical-peak pricing）这两种最常见的时变费率方案，各自仅纠正了约10%的价格扭曲。第二，基于历史价格的复杂费率结构常常适得其反。第三，带有价格上限的实时电价可以获取大部分潜在效率收益，同时限制客户风险。

title: Understanding and Valuing Human Connections to Deep-Sea Methane Seeps Off Costa Rica
abstract: Methane seeps are highly productive ecosystems that provide carbon sequestration services, host diverse communities including endemic species, and serve as habitats for commercial fisheries. Little is known about the economic value the public places on them. Discrete Choice Experiments (DCEs) are administered to a sample of Costa Rican taxpayers to evaluate their willingness to pay (WTP) in monetary terms using tradeoffs made in a survey context involving three of the main attributes of methane seep ecosystems to provide insights for future conservation and management efforts. Extensive effort is devoted to understanding how Costa Ricans view different aspects of the deep sea. We find that they associate it with strange animals, natural resources, the unknown, and being far from reach. Perhaps surprisingly, they underestimate how much they know about the deep sea. We find that WTP for methane seep protection is the highest for programs that protect seeps with endemic species, followed by seeps with high climate change mitigation potential and commercial fishing habitat. Higher-income groups and women are more likely to prefer options that increase the current level of protection. We discuss how science communication and community engagement contribute to care expressed toward the deep sea.
abstract_zh: 甲烷渗漏区是生产力很高的生态系统，可提供碳封存服务，孕育包括特有物种在内的多样化群落，并为商业渔业提供栖息地。公众对其所赋予的经济价值知之甚少。我们对哥斯达黎加纳税人样本进行了离散选择实验（DCE），在包含甲烷渗漏生态系统三个主要属性的调查情境中，通过权衡取舍来评估他们的支付意愿（WTP）（以货币计），为未来的保护和管理工作提供见解。我们投入大量精力，了解哥斯达黎加人如何看待深海的不同方面。我们发现，他们将深海与奇异的动物、自然资源、未知以及遥不可及联系在一起。或许令人惊讶的是，他们低估了自己对深海的了解程度。我们发现，在保护甲烷渗漏区的项目中，对保护有特有物种的渗漏区的支付意愿最高，其次是具有高气候变化缓解潜力的渗漏区，以及商业渔业栖息地。收入较高的群体和女性更可能偏好那些能提高当前保护水平的选项。我们讨论了科学传播和社区参与如何促进人们对深海的关切。

title: Regulating Untaxable Externalities: Are Vehicle Air Pollution Standards Effective and Efficient?
abstract: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of US Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new US vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99 percent, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and that increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, though both reforms have complex effects on inequality.
abstract_zh: 全球有14亿辆乘用车。政府应如何监管其空气污染排放？庇古税在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而依赖尾气标准，即限制新车每英里的空气污染排放量。我们评估了这些标准的有效性和效率，它们是美国《清洁空气法》对交通运输实施监管的核心，同时也评估了若干反事实政策。我们表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车每英里的空气污染排放量已大幅下降，降幅超过99%。利用半个世纪数据的若干研究设计表明，尾气标准是这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气标准并不具备成本效益，部分原因在于它未能激励淘汰老旧车辆，而老旧车辆贡献了大部分排放。为研究反事实政策，我们构建了车队的解析模型和定量模型。对这些模型的分析表明，更严格的尾气标准会提高社会福利；而提高高排放车辆的登记费，则可通过加速报废带来更大的收益，尽管这两项改革对不平等都有复杂的影响。

title: Estimating the Costs and Benefits of Fuel Economy Standards
venue: NBER Book Series: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Fuel-economy standards for new vehicles are a primary policy instrument in many countries to reduce the carbon footprint of the transportation sector. These standards have many channels of costs and benefit, impacting sales, composition, vehicle attributes, miles traveled and externalities in the new-car fleet, as well as the composition and size of the used fleet. We develop a tractable analytical framework to examine the welfare effects of fuel-economy standards, and apply it to the recent government proposal to roll back fuel-economy standards. We find that our combined, multi-market vehicle choice model implies that the proposal would increase the size of the vehicle fleet over time, and also generates smaller welfare gains than models with a less rich structure of the vehicle market, such as the one used in the analysis associated with the 2018 Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) announcement. The disparities across the two models appear to result from the absence of feedback effects in the NPRM analysis. We stress the importance of instead using a multi-market vehicle choice model to provide the most accurate predictions of costs and benefits. We also derive bounds that can serve as a check on the theoretical consistency of such analyses, and that offer insights into the magnitudes of potential errors resulting from imperfect multi-market integration.
abstract_zh: 新车燃油经济性标准是许多国家降低交通运输部门碳足迹的主要政策工具。这些标准通过多种渠道产生成本和收益，影响销量、车型结构、车辆属性、行驶里程以及新车队的外部性，并影响二手车队的构成与规模。我们构建了一个易于处理的解析框架，考察燃油经济性标准的福利效应，并将其应用于政府近期提出的放松燃油经济性标准的方案。我们发现，我们结合多个市场的车辆选择模型表明，该方案将随时间推移扩大车队规模，而且所带来的福利收益也小于那些车辆市场结构较简单的模型，例如2018年《拟议规则制定通知》（NPRM）所采用的模型。两种模型之间的差异似乎源于NPRM分析中缺乏反馈效应。我们强调，应当改用多市场车辆选择模型，以对成本和收益作出最为准确的预测。我们还推导了一些界限，可用于检验此类分析的理论一致性，并揭示由多市场整合不完善所可能导致的误差大小。

title: Vehicle Scrappage and Gasoline Policy
abstract: We estimate the sensitivity of scrap decisions to changes in used car values and show how this “scrap elasticity” produces emissions leakage under fuel efficiency standards, a process known as the Gruenspecht effect. We first estimate the effect of gasoline prices on used vehicle values and scrappage of vehicles with different fuel economies. We then estimate the scrap elasticity itself, which we find to be −0.7. When applied in a model of fuel economy standards, 13–16 percent of the expected fuel savings leak away through the used vehicle market. This effect rivals or exceeds the importance of the often-cited mileage rebound effect. (JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们估计了报废决策对二手车价值变化的敏感性，并说明这种“报废弹性”如何在燃油经济性标准下产生排放泄漏，即所谓的Gruenspecht效应。我们首先估计了汽油价格对二手车价值以及不同燃油经济性车辆报废率的影响。随后，我们估计报废弹性本身，发现其为−0.7。将其应用于燃油经济性标准模型时，预期燃油节省的13%–16%会通过二手车市场泄漏掉。这一效应与常被提及的里程反弹效应相当，甚至更大。（JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58）

title: Evaluating U.S. Fuel Economy Standards in a Model with Producer and Household Heterogeneity
abstract: This paper employs an empirically estimated model to study the equilibrium effects of an increase in the US corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) standards. I identify and model heterogeneity across firms and find that the profit impacts of CAFE fall almost entirely on domestic producers. The welfare analyses consider the simultaneous household decision of vehicle and miles traveled, allowing direct comparison with a gasoline tax. Finally, I consider dynamic impacts in the used car market. I find these comprise nearly half the gross welfare cost of CAFE and fall disproportionately on low-income households. Contrary to previous results, the overall welfare costs are regressive. (JEL H24, L51, L62)
abstract_zh: 本文采用一个经验估计的模型，研究美国企业平均燃油经济性（CAFE）标准提高所产生的均衡效应。我识别并建模了企业之间的异质性，发现CAFE对利润的影响几乎完全落在国内生产商身上。福利分析同时考虑了家庭在车辆选择与行驶里程上的决策，从而可以与汽油税进行直接比较。最后，我考察了二手车市场中的动态影响。我发现这些影响约占CAFE毛福利成本的近一半，并且不成比例地落在低收入家庭身上。与以往结果相反，CAFE的总体福利成本具有累退性。（JEL H24, L51, L62）

title: Fuel Economy and Safety: The Influences of Vehicle Class and Driver Behavior
abstract: Fuel economy standards change the composition of the vehicle fleet, influencing accident safety. The direction and size of the effect depend on the combination of vehicles in the fleet. I provide empirical estimates of vehicle safety across classes, accounting for unobserved driving behavior and selection. I apply the model to the present structure of US fuel economy standards, accounting for shifts in the composition of vehicle ownership, and estimate an adverse safety effect of 33 cents per gallon of gasoline saved. I show how two alternative regulatory provisions fully offset this effect, producing a nearzero change in accident fatalities. (JEL D12, L51, L62, Q48, R41)
abstract_zh: 燃油经济性标准会改变车队的构成，从而影响事故安全性。这种影响的方向和大小取决于车队中车型的组合。在考虑未观测到的驾驶行为和选择性的情况下，我提供了不同车型车辆安全性的实证估计。我将该模型应用于美国燃油经济性标准的现行结构，并考虑车辆拥有构成的变化，估计出每节省一加仑汽油会产生33美分的不利安全效应。我展示了两种替代性监管条款可以完全抵消这一效应，使事故死亡人数几乎没有变化。（JEL D12, L51, L62, Q48, R41）

title: Unintended Consequences from Nested State & Federal Regulations: The Case of the Pavley Greenhouse-Gas-per-Mile Limits
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Fourteen U.S. states recently pledged to adopt limits on greenhouse gases (GHGs) per mile of light-duty automobiles. Previous analyses predicted this action would significantly reduce emissions from new cars in these states, but ignored possible offsetting emissions increases from policy-induced adjustments in new car markets in other (non-adopting) states and in the used car market. Such offsets (or "leakage") reflect the fact that the state-level effort interacts with the national corporate average fuel economy (CAFE) standard: the state-level initiative effectively loosens the national standard and gives automakers scope to profitably increase sales of high-emissions automobiles in non-adopting states. In addition, although the state-level effort may well spur the invention of fuel-and emissions-saving technologies, interactions with the federal CAFE standard limit the nationwide emissions reductions from such advances. Using a multi-period numerical simulation model, we find that 70-80 percent of the emissions reductions from new cars in adopting states are offset by emissions leakage. This research examines a particular instance of a general issue of policy significance -namely, problems from "nested" federal and state environmental regulations. Such nesting implies that similar leakage difficulties are likely to arise under several newly proposed state-level initiatives.
abstract_zh: 十四个美国州近期承诺采用每英里温室气体（GHG）排放限值，适用于轻型汽车。先前分析预测，这一行动将显著减少这些州新车的排放，但忽视了在政策影响下，其他（未采用该限值的）州的新车市场和二手车市场可能产生的抵消性排放增加。这种抵消（即“泄漏”）反映了这样一个事实：州级行动与全国企业平均燃油经济性（CAFE）标准相互作用，州级举措实际上放松了全国标准，使汽车制造商有空间在未采用该限值的州有利可图地增加高排放汽车的销售。此外，尽管州级行动可能确实促进了节能减排技术的发明，但与联邦CAFE标准的相互作用限制了这些进步带来的全国性减排效果。利用多期数值模拟模型，我们发现，采用该限值的州中新车产生的排放减少，有70%–80%被排放泄漏所抵消。本研究考察了一个具有普遍政策意义问题的特定案例，即联邦与州环境法规“嵌套”所带来的问题。这种嵌套意味着，在若干新提议的州级举措下，也可能出现类似的泄漏困难。

title: Fuel Economy, Car Class Mix, and Safety
venue: American Economic Review - Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Fuel economy standards change the composition of the vehicle fleet, potentially influencing accident fatality risks. I estimate the direction and magnitude of this impact, introducing a correction for selection on driver behavior. A policy application using my new estimates shows that the present distinction between light trucks and cars in fuel economy rules has very negative consequences for overall safety: Each MPG increment to the standard results in an additional 150 fatalities per year in expectation. My correction for selection is pivotal in this finding. I then demonstrate a simple alternative regulation that can produce near-zero changes in accident fatalities.
abstract_zh: 燃油经济性标准会改变车队的构成，可能影响事故致死风险。我估计了这一影响的方向和大小，并引入了对驾驶员行为选择的修正。利用我的新估计所做的政策应用表明，当前燃油经济性规则中区分轻型卡车与轿车的做法，对整体安全造成了非常负面的后果：每提高一个MPG的标准，预计每年将额外导致150人死亡。我的选择修正对这一发现至关重要。随后，我展示了一种简单的替代性监管方案，它可以使事故死亡人数几乎没有变化。

title: Distributional and Efficiency Impacts of Increased U.S. Gasoline Taxes
abstract: We examine the impacts of increased US gasoline taxes in a model that links the markets for new, used, and scrapped vehicles and recognizes the considerable heterogeneity among households and cars. Household choice parameters derive from an estimation procedure that integrates individual choices for car ownership and miles traveled. We find that each cent-per-gallon increase in the price of gasoline reduces the equilibrium gasoline consumption by about 0.2 percent. Taking account of revenue recycling, the impact of a 25-cent gasoline tax increase on the average household is about $30 per year (2001 dollars). Distributional impacts depend importantly on how additional revenues from the tax increase are recycled. (JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71)
abstract_zh: 我们在一个将新车、二手车和报废车辆市场联系起来的模型中，考察美国汽油税提高的影响，该模型同时承认家庭与汽车之间的显著异质性。家庭的选择参数来自一个将车辆拥有与行驶里程个体选择整合在一起的估计程序。我们发现，汽油价格每提高一美分/加仑，均衡汽油消费量约减少0.2%。考虑税收返还之后，汽油税每加仑提高25美分对普通家庭的影响约为每年30美元（2001年美元）。分配效应在很大程度上取决于增税所得收入的返还方式。（JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71）
